name: central quartic potential in 2D, explicit Euler kernel

claims.why: TRAP (simultaneous update written sequentially, done right): explicit Euler evaluates the force at the OLD q, which in straight-line code needs the temporaries tx, ty. It changes L = q x p by -h^2 p x grad V(q), nonzero off the radial direction
the h^1 term of L(Phi(z)) - L(z) is h (p x p - q x grad V) = 0, since grad V is parallel to q
the h^2 term -p x grad V(q) does not vanish identically
